atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas for a painted fantasy board-game map. Create exactly TWELVE isolated water scenery miniatures in FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, row-major order, 1536x1152 canvas. Center each sprite within its own equal cell, at most 64% of cell width and height, wide completely transparent gaps on every side. Actual transparent alpha background, no background color, no paper, checkerboard, labels, grid, or lettering.
Style: finely hand-painted European storybook gouache fantasy map, elevated three-quarter overhead view, softly lit upper left, understated muted grey stone and weathered brown timber, faded flax sails, dusky teal-grey waterline details. Match earthy painted map structures, not shiny 3D models, cartoons, icons, photorealism, thick outlines or glowing art. Low contrast; miniature silhouettes readable at 35-50 pixels. Objects are floating or rising from water: NO broad ground islands, NO painted blue water disks or rectangular water patches. Only a few thin, broken, translucent grey-blue ripples around contact edges, faint small off-white wakes where relevant. Water around objects MUST be transparent so existing map texture shows through.
Exact row-major subjects:
1. small empty wooden rowing boat with two oars laid inside
2. low wooden fishing skiff with wicker basket and a single tiny furled sail
3. compact old sailing boat with one faded linen triangular sail, gentle tiny wake
4. modest timber log raft carrying two tied crates
5. low cluster of three smooth grey rocks breaking the water surface
6. slender weathered sea stack with a natural arch near waterline
7. small old round stone lighthouse on a very compact rocky footing, unlit lantern
8. tiny thatched fishing hut on four timber stilts descending directly into water
9. half-drowned ruined round stone watchtower, broken top and submerged doorway
10. two weathered pillars with one broken stone arch emerging from water
11. three tiny old wooden mooring buoys on ropes, one compact cluster
12. wrecked wooden boat with tilted broken mast emerging from water.
All 12 distinct objects isolated; strict 4x3 grid; enough transparent padding to crop each cell cleanly. No land patches or heavy shadows.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas for a painted fantasy board-game map. Create exactly TWELVE isolated aquatic wildlife/nature miniatures in FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, row-major order, 1536x1152 canvas. Center each sprite in its equal cell, max 64% cell width and height, wide completely transparent gutters. Actual alpha transparency, no paper, opaque background, checkerboard, grid, lettering or labels.
Style: delicate European storybook gouache fantasy map, gently elevated three-quarter overhead view, fine hand-painted texture, soft light upper left. Muted slate blue-grey animals, olive greens, grey rocks, weathered brown wood, low contrast and subdued highlights. Same perspective on all. Readable silhouettes at 30-50 pixels, no polished 3D look, cartoon outlines, neon, enormous waves or drop shadows. Animals/nature emerge from water. NO opaque water disk or blue ground patch under any object. Only a few narrow broken translucent blue-grey ripples and very small soft off-white splashes at waterline; all between ripples remains genuinely transparent to show existing water map texture.
Exact row-major subjects:
1. one dolphin leaping in an arc, anatomically clear curved body, tiny entry splash
2. two smaller dolphins jumping side by side, different heights, compact playful pair
3. a large whale surfacing, long curved dark slate back and small dorsal fin, short delicate blow from its head
4. a whale tail fluke raised above water, tiny fading ring of ripples
5. shy Loch Ness-like creature: curved long neck with small head, two low separated back humps, muted moss-grey, elegant and mysterious rather than scary
6. compact cluster of lily pads with two tiny faded ivory blossoms
7. small tuft of olive reeds rising directly from shallow water, no earth or island
8. half-submerged pale weathered driftwood log with a short branch
9. two small white-grey gulls perched on a low rounded rock
10. one brown otter resting on a low mossy rock at the waterline
11. small circular fish ripple with one silver fish briefly jumping, tiny delicate splash
12. low rounded mossy lake rocks, three irregular pebbled humps with thin waterline ripples.
Strict 4x3 grid, one scene per cell; genuine transparency and wide padding. Graceful compact creatures, no people, no unrelated objects.
